'''0.11d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added support for [[wikipedia:DirectX|DirectX 9]] and added HDR audio support.

==Changelog==
* The “crouch” position animation has been changed
* Game sounds changed (HDR audio adaptation)
* The minimum system requirements compatibility check integrated into the download/installer
* DirectX 9 support added (DX9 video cards under Windows Vista and Windows 7 should work)
* Lighting fixed on [[Chemical Plant]] and [[Radar]] locations
* The possibility of using objects through a wall has been removed

===Bug fixes===
* Bug causing the match to end prematurely, prior to the level loading, has been fixed
* Crash occurring when dying in a trap left from a “server-disconnected” player has been fixed.
* HDAO error to causing an FPS drop has been fixed
* Game interface error fixed (shop items were unavailable to purchase)
* Cylindrical collision on objects has been fixed
